name: Smith Machine Incline Scapular Press
steps: Set the bench to an incline with the bar above your shoulders and lie back with feet flat.
Grasp the bar just outside shoulder width, release the hooks and hold it above you with your arms extended.
Push the bar smoothly upward a few inches by protracting your shoulder blades forward around your rib cage.
Pause briefly at peak protraction, then slowly let your shoulder blades glide back against the bench.
tips: Keep your elbow angle steady so the movement comes from your shoulder blades.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders toward your ears as you push the bar higher.
